stem: Which detail from paragraph 2 supports the idea that the Nile River spans diverse areas?

options.label: F
options.text: The Nile River is the longest river in the world, measuring about 4,100 miles in length.

options.label: G
options.text: The White Nile begins in Rwanda, and the Blue Nile begins in Ethiopia.

options.label: H
options.text: The two main tributaries of the Nile River meet in Sudan to form one river.

options.label: J
options.text: The Nile River flows through cities as well as remote deserts and mountain regions.
